criteria.description: Validate shipped static GLB, official format validation, scale/origin, exact geometry/texture budgets and provenance.

Inspect every frozen diagnostic and turntable frame against references; silhouette, construction, proportions and materials must meet the brief. Required: Low oblong ovoid fossil external mould in shallow negative hyporelief on thin irregular full-volume sandstone slab; Broad rounded end opposing narrower truncated region; smooth central body depression and narrow frill-like transversely grooved marginal zones; No living mollusc, eyes, shell, appendages, muscular-foot certainty or invented underside anatomy. Scope: Original simplified Kimberella quadrata fossil-specimen study informed by South Australian Museum P49391 photograph published by scientist-curated Ediacaran.org, not a replica, scan or whole living animal reconstruction. Primary Evans,Droser,Erwin2021 text and caption describe negative-hyporelief external moulds and interpretation uncertainty; their Fig2 specimens LV-FUN001/P35660 are contextual text only, not the selected viewed specimen. Nominal fossil length70mm in65x100x7mm sandstone slab illustrative, not measurement from source scale bar. Central impression preserved morphology, ruffled margin interpretation not settled muscular-foot identity. Hidden slab thickness and neutral sandstone palette artistic.

Broad rounded end opposing narrower truncated region; smooth central body depression and narrow frill-like transversely grooved marginal zones
No living mollusc, eyes, shell, appendages, muscular-foot certainty or invented underside anatomy
concept_decisions: Keep shallow negative impression, broad rounded and narrow truncated ends. Avoid concept raised snail-like relief if present: central body must lie below bedding plane, not domed living shell. Use narrow longitudinal side zones and short marginal transverse ruffles, not Dickinsonia full-width repeated modules or Spriggina median segmentation. P49391 observed central elongated smooth area, uneven frill-border grooves, rounded lower end and disturbed narrow upper end. Simplify preservation damage without inventing eyes/proboscis. No photograph grain, reconstructed organs or copied scan.
intended_use: Static educational fossil teaching specimen at256-512px
